verdict.rationale: Jan documents a built-in, OpenAI-compatible local REST server at localhost:1337. The API reference covers GET /v1/models, POST /v1/chat/completions (streaming, tool calling) and an Anthropic-compatible /v1/messages, each with curl examples and sample responses. However, the documented surface only covers model inference, not the app's own features (assistants, model downloads, threads, MCP config), and probes found no OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: API control of app features beyond inference (assistants, downloads, projects), a published OpenAPI/machine-readable spec, a versioning/stability policy, independent hands-on corroboration.
